title: Temptation Doesn't Always Look Dangerous
devotional: Temptation does not always arrive looking like a terrible decision. Sometimes it looks small, harmless, or even reasonable. That is what makes it dangerous. A thought can seem insignificant. A conversation can seem innocent. A few minutes of scrolling can seem harmless. But small choices can become doors to larger patterns. Today, don't only ask whether something looks obviously wrong. Ask where it is taking you. Wisdom learns to recognize the direction of a choice before the consequences become obvious.
mind_check: What is one activity or choice that seems harmless at first but has led you toward temptation before?
body_move: Create distance from one activity, place, or situation that repeatedly pulls you in the wrong direction.
spirit_move: Ask God for discernment today. Before making a questionable choice, pause and ask where that choice is leading you.
way_out: When something looks harmless but I know where it can lead, I will __________.
prayer: Father, give me wisdom to recognize temptation before it becomes obvious. Help me look beyond the moment and see where my choices are leading me. Give me the courage to walk away from anything that pulls me away from You. Teach me to choose wisdom, discipline, and obedience. Amen.
action: Write down one choice that has looked harmless in the past but eventually led you somewhere you did not want to go. Write one boundary you will set around it.
